northStar: Become the standard assurance rail agents call automatically before consequential actions and after important outputs.
promise: Before your agent acts, OCN checks evidence, authority, freshness, policy and intent. After it acts, OCN leaves a verifiable receipt.

trustModel.principle: Verifiable assurance for specific claims in a specific context at a specific time; never a universal trust score.

freshnessRepeat10.interpretation: operator-controlled public repeatability proof, not independent demand

failure.interpretation: Base rejected the facilitator relayer transaction as an underpriced replacement transaction; this is payment-settlement infrastructure evidence, not a deterministic OCN intent-kernel failure.

paymentIntentRepeat10.interpretation: Strong small-sample public operation evidence, but 90% settlement success is not production-ready payment reliability and does not prove independent demand.

currentSprint.name: 20-Call Reliability -> Independent Payer -> Shadow -> Paid Pilot
nextCriticalMoves: Run 20 payment-intent and 20 freshness calls with continue-on-failure and publish success/error/latency distributions without retrying failed signed payments.
Treat facilitator-settlement failures as a separate reliability layer; evaluate a facilitator fallback or dedicated facilitator only if the measured error rate remains material.
Add official x402 payment-identifier/idempotency semantics before any automatic retry policy so settlement ambiguity cannot create double-charge risk.
Verify x402 Bazaar/Agentic.Market discovery and publish MCP/JS installation paths.
Recruit independent x402/MCP/AgentCore builders; earn M4 only with a genuinely independent repeat-paying agent.
Run Payment Intent Shadow with a real payment/AP/commerce workflow and Decision Assurance Shadow with a real public-sector/enterprise workflow.
Measure useful catches, false positives/negatives, review-time change, p95 latency, audit completeness and cost per trusted event.
Convert one buyer-confirmed useful finding into a paid design-partner/institutional pilot.
Enable buyer-approved deterministic enforcement gates, expand to a second workflow, then attack hosted scale, sovereign deployment and independent assurance.
currentSprint.externalUnlock: Independent repeat-paying agent + one buyer-confirmed Shadow Mode finding.
